name: Expanded Spell Kenning
benefit: When you use your spell kenning class feature, you can select a spell from either the druid or the witch spell list.
flavor: You are learned in a broader range of spell traditions than most.
text:
You are learned in a broader range of spell traditions than most.

**Prerequisites**: Spell kenning class feature.

**Benefit**: When you use your spell kenning class feature, you can select a spell from either the druid or the witch spell list.
